thought.text: The shim is ready. Now let me set up the instance directory and run the system preparation. First, copy to `/opt/qisutu`:

reasoning_content:
The shim is currently in a clean state. Next, I'll test the mariadb portion of the shim in advance (since the apt installation is required first).

Now I'll set up the instance:
1. Copy /workspace → /opt/qisutu
2. Run `QISUTU_INSTALL_LANGUAGE=de ./install.sh`

Wait a sec — one important check: `install.sh` has `set -euo pipefail`, and the apt install will take some time (mariadb-server is about 200MB). A single command has a 600-second timeout. `apt-get update` + `install apache2 mariadb-server perl modules` might take 2–5 minutes. It should fit within 600 seconds.

I'll create a log file for the full execution of the install script: `/var/log/qisutu-install-run.log`.

action.command: mkdir -p /opt && cp -a /workspace /opt/qisutu && rm -rf /opt/qisutu/.git && ls /opt/qisutu | head && du -sh /opt/qisutu
